split_policy.train: stratified portion of the official public train split
split_policy.validation: stratified 15% portion of the official public train split
split_policy.test: official public validation split; never use for tuning

text_policy: Strip leading/trailing whitespace and collapse whitespace only. Preserve case, spelling, punctuation, emoji, hashtags and regional expressions.
duplicate_policy: Detect exact duplicates after Unicode NFKC, case-folding and whitespace collapse. Remove conflicting-label groups; otherwise keep one canonical row, preferring the official validation row to protect the project test split.
